<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 8pt 0 4pt"><B>Acquisition of Goldfield Equipment and Inventory (03-26-2024)</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&#8201;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&#8201;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&#8201;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; margin-left: 0">&#8201;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 10pt 0pt 0 0; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">This agreement
hereby amends the Letter of Commitment executed by the Parties, as defined therein and as referenced below, on or around February 22,
2024; and shall be known as the Amendment to the Letter of Commitment.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 10pt 0pt 0pt 0.4in; text-align: justify">1. Pursuant to the terms of paragraph
7 of the Letter of Commitment, MineralRite Corporation (&quot;RITE&quot;) wishes to purchase, and OWNERS wish to sell, all remaining equipment,
inventory, spare parts, tools and other physical components used by or used in the former business of Goldfield International, Inc.(&quot;EQUIPMENT&quot;),
wherever said EQUIPMENT may presently be in use, in storage, in transit or otherwise located, anywhere in the world, including but not
limited to the two known trailer locations in Utah and a on-site in the Democratic Republic of the Congo .</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 10pt 0pt 0pt 0.4in; text-align: justify">2. RITE and OWNERS (&quot;PARTIES&quot;)
have agreed to consummate this purchase and sale as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 10pt 0pt 0pt 0.8in; text-align: justify">Alex Harmon, on behalf of OWNERS,
will re-assert control over the two trailers of equipment, and assemble an itemized list of the equipment contained therein and elsewhere;
assign a realistic sale value for each item listed thereon; and determine, in his sole discretion, if he believes each such item should
be kept or sold based on its usefulness to the project contemplated herein; and endeavor to sell all such items that he has determined
should be sold. The proceeds for all such items sold will be promptly deposited, directly or transmitted by Zelle or other means, to
the financial account of RITE and will be accounted for accordingly.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 10pt 0pt 0pt 0.8in; text-align: justify">Based on the preliminary analysis
estimate of the PARTIES, and subject to adjustment, such adjustment to be completed with 30 days of the execution of this formal Amendment
to Letter of Commitment, RITE will issue to OWNERS the collective sum of 300 shares of RITE Preferred Series C, each share of which is
convertible into 400,000 shares of RITE common stock, to be registered in the individual names of OWNERS pursuant to instructions provided
to RITE by OWNERS under the original Letter of Commitment.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 10pt 0pt 0pt 0.8in; text-align: justify">For the personal services of Alex Harmon
(&quot;OWNER CONSULTANT&quot;) being performed hereunder, RITE will reimburse OWNER CONSULTANT for all out-of-pocket expenses paid by
OWNER</P>
</DIV>
</CENTER>

<DIV STYLE="width: 8.5in">

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 10pt 0pt 0pt 0.8in; text-align: justify">CONSULTANT and issue an amount of no less
than 50 shares of RITE Preferred Series C, each share of which is convertible into 400,000 shares of RITE common stock as shall be mutually
determined and agreeable to the RITE and OWNER CONSULTANT.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 10pt 0pt 0pt 0.4in; text-align: justify">3. The Parties hereto also agree to execute
and supply all documentation required to evidence this agreement and their performance of duties required under this agreement as may
be required by any legal, accounting and/or tax professionals, and further agree to replace this agreement, when and if needed, with a
more formal document containing substantively similar terms and conditions as those contained herein but written in such manner as may
be prescribed by said aforementioned legal, accounting and/or tax professionals.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 10pt 0pt 20pt; text-align: justify">It is my hope that this simple letter
of agreement accurately reflects all of the terms and conditions to which we have agreed, and will be adequate to serve each Party's
purpose until such time as a more formal document may be required and assembled.</P>
